title: Remove leftover matplotlib box of sphinxgallery periodictable
body:
Removes the freestanding matplotlib box and x and y axis of gallery/ptable.py, which was previously done in merge request 4000 and is part of issue #1870. 

# Checklist: `x` (done) or `~` (irrelevant)

- [x] [I am familiar with **ASE's contribution guidelines.**](https://ase-lib.org/development/contribute.html)

- [~] [**Unit tests** have been added for new or changed code.](https://ase-lib.org/development/tests.html)

author: elisabeth.keller

comments.author: mnygp
comments.body: Removing `tight_layerout()` makes it so that there is quite a lot of whitespace around the plot. I would suggest adding i back in

comments.author: elisabeth.keller
comments.body: Yes, this makes sense. Now changed with 817d577b525886d3b8b99501685a5e870a905c2f , which removes unnecessary whitespace around the figure.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Suggests adding back tight_layout() to fix whitespace issue around the plot.

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body: This looks good to me as well, except that I am not sure if we need `changelog.d` for this type of change. The change log is mostly to let users know the changes on the ASE usage, which is not the present case. Also, this documentation change is not associated with the next ASE version; this will be appeared rather quickly on the web, at latest within one day.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Suggests removing the changelog.d entry as unnecessary for this type of change.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
Indeed let's remove the changelog entry in this case (those who need that level of detail can always see the git log).

Thanks!

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Agrees with removing the changelog entry, implying a concrete change to the PR.
